project_details.name: ToolBox / Garage Tracker
project_details.vibe: Modern industrial design, rugged, reliable, high-contrast, tactical toolbox feel.

typography.heading_font: Barlow Condensed (or similar strong condensed sans like Bebas Neue)

layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first rugged layout. Generous spacing (p-4 to p-6) to ensure easy thumb reach and high visibility.
layout_and_spacing.buttons: Large touch targets, minimum 48px height. No pill shapes; use rounded-sm or sharp corners.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Flat, tactical minimalist. No soft shadows. Rely on 1px solid strokes (border-zinc-700) and inner glow highlights.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Dark bottom tab bar with bright yellow/orange active states. Utilize a prominent Floating Action Button (FAB) for the primary 'Add Tool' action.

components.buttons: Primary: Solid #FFB300 background with #000000 text. Secondary: Transparent with #3F3F46 border and #FFFFFF text. Heavy font weight.
components.inputs: Solid dark background (bg-zinc-900), 1px border. Focus state illuminates the border with the accent color (#FFB300) and increases border thickness to 2px.
components.tags: Geometric shape, filled with 15% opacity of the accent color, bordered by 1px solid accent color.
components.lists: Cardless, dense layout. Separated by a crisp 1px bottom border. Thumbnail image on the left, high-contrast title, and subtle grey subtitle.
components.photo_capture: Full-screen camera view with a large, high-visibility yellow capture button.
components.status_indicators: Small, bright dot indicators for check-in (Green/White) and check-out (Orange/Red).

motion.general: Snap transitions. Fast, mechanical, and precise. Avoid slow, floaty ease-ins. Think 'heavy machinery locking into place'.
motion.click_states: Scale down slightly (scale-95) to mimic pushing a stiff physical button.

media.description: Dark matte black metal texture with neon safety orange line. Use as a splash screen or empty state background.
Close up of a yellow power drill. Use as a placeholder for tool images in the inventory.
Dark garage workbench. Use as a fallback image for locations (Garage/Toolbox) or category headers.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the React Native Expo app with a dark theme as the default.
2. Set up React Navigation: A Bottom Tab Navigator (Inventory, Borrowers, Reports) and a Stack Navigator for flows (Tool Details, Add/Edit Tool, Check-In/Out).
3. Apply the 'Performance Pro / Tactical Industrial' aesthetic. Strictly use the provided color palette (#0A0A0A base, #FFB300 accents).
4. Use a local storage solution (AsyncStorage or SQLite via expo-sqlite) to persist tools, tags, locations, borrowers, and base64 strings of captured photos.
5. For icons, use Lucide React Native. Ensure the stroke widths are crisp.
6. Build reusable, tactical UI components: A hard-edged primary button (bg-yellow-500, text-black, uppercase), text inputs with sharp focus states, and geometric tags.
7. Implement the Check-In/Out modal with a segmented control or toggle for 'Select from list' vs 'Free text entry' for borrowers.
8. Use `expo-camera` or `expo-image-picker` to capture photos, converting them to base64 before saving to state/db.
9. Use `expo-print` to generate PDF inventory/checkout reports and `expo-sharing` to allow users to export them.
10. Ensure all touchable/interactive elements have `testID` attributes mapped to their role (e.g., testID='add-tool-submit-button').
